official.application_route: Apply through the DIRBDE online form (https://postulacionbuch.uchile.cl/auth/login) between 21 September and 19 October 2026 (12:00 noon) with the RSH Cartola attached; admission to the chosen programme is obtained separately through SAES.
official.citizenship_residency: Eligibility is published for students in the fourth year of enseñanza media in 2026 who sit the PAES admission 2027 battery and request MINEDUC student benefits; no separate nationality or residency rule is published.
official.international_eligibility: The published route is the Chilean secondary-education system only (cuarto año de enseñanza media 2026 plus PAES admission 2027 and Registro Social de Hogares); no international-applicant category is published.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Cualquier carrera o programa de pregrado de la Universidad de Chile; no field restriction.
official.duration: Duración formal de la carrera o programa de pregrado, con renovación anual.
official.description: La Beca Universidad de Chile (BUCH) es un beneficio de arancel que se otorga a 100 jóvenes de excelencia académica, financiando el valor completo de la matrícula y el arancel de cualquier carrera o programa de pregrado de la Universidad de Chile. Su objetivo es reconocer y premiar el excelente rendimiento académico y las necesidades de apoyo económico de jóvenes talentos del país. Se rige por el Decreto Universitario N°0013621, de 20 de abril de 2026.
official.program_type: Beca interna de arancel (internal tuition scholarship) managed by DIRBDE, combining academic excellence and socioeconomic need

verification.notes: Official uchile.cl convocatoria page, its attached BUCH regulation (Decreto Universitario N°0013621, 20-04-2026), the live DIRBDE application portal, and the official convocatorias listing were all checked on 2026-10-10; deadline, results dates, selection weighting and renewal rules come from the convocatoria page. No fixed monetary value is published because the award funds the chosen career's full matrícula and arancel, so amount, currency and cadence are not stated by the awarding body.

applicant_utility.summary: BUCH is one of the most selective internal awards in Chile: exactly 100 places nationwide, ranked purely by the PAES weighted score, and it pays the complete matrícula and arancel of any Universidad de Chile undergraduate programme - but no living stipend, travel or extra costs. The application itself is quick, one online form plus your Registro Social de Hogares Cartola, and it runs in parallel with, not instead of, your SAES admission. The decisive trap is the gratuidad veto: if MINEDUC assigns you gratuidad or Beca Vocación de Profesor, the state benefit prevails and BUCH is not awarded, so treat BUCH as the fallback for strong PAES candidates who miss out on free tuition.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving Chilean secondary-school leavers inside the 90% RSH socioeconomic band who did not receive MINEDUC gratuidad and want a fully tuition-covered place at the Universidad de Chile.
application_readiness_checklist: Download your current Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares and confirm the household is within the 90% socioeconomic tramo before opening the form
Register for PAES admission 2027 on the DEMRE platform and activate the informed consent that shares your PAES results with universities
Apply to MINEDUC student benefits for 2027 (FUAS) and complete the FUAS for academic period 2027 in October 2026
Submit the DIRBDE online form with the Cartola attached well before 19 October 2026, 12:00 noon
Include a Universidad de Chile programme among your SAES preferences and be ready to formalise the matrícula in the enrolment call
Check the preselection result on 4 January 2027 and the final selection on 18 January 2027
common_rejection_risks: Missing the DEMRE informed consent, which makes PAES results invisible to the BUCH ranking
Being assigned MINEDUC gratuidad or Beca Vocación de Profesor, which automatically voids the BUCH award
Submitting the form after the 12:00 noon cut-off on 19 October 2026
Failing to formalise the matrícula after being summoned to enrol, which cancels the selection
A secondary-school average below 6.0 or a household outside the 90% RSH tramo at application time
Weak PAES scores: with only 100 places, the weighted ranking, not effort, decides the outcome
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs (housing, food, transport) and any fees beyond matrícula and arancel are not covered; applicants must self-fund these or layer CAE/FSCU credit and JUNAEB maintenance scholarships (BAE, BPR, BMES) on top of BUCH.
document_audit: The Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares must be current at application time and must match the household actually surveyed - stale or mismatched Cartolas are the classic failure of this process
If the Cartola cannot be produced, request the Informe Social early, ideally through the social worker of the academic unit you intend to enter
PAES scores reach the University only through the DEMRE consent; without the consent your Cartola and form are complete but unrankable
Keep proof of MINEDUC benefit application (FUAS) because renewal depends on re-doing it each academic period
alerts: Gratuidad veto: any MINEDUC gratuidad or equivalent benefit assignment disqualifies you from BUCH, so do not count on holding both
Three deadlines run in parallel: BUCH form 19 October 2026 (12:00), FUAS/MINEDUC benefits in October 2026, and PAES in December 2026
Preselection (4 January 2027) and final selection (18 January 2027) depend entirely on PAES results - your December 2026 PAES sitting effectively decides the award
Renewal is conditional: at least 70% academic progress in year one and 80% from year two, plus FOCES and annual socioeconomic re-accreditation with the unit's social worker
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the DIRBDE portal, submit the online form with the RSH Cartola between 21 September and 19 October 2026, sit PAES in December 2026, check the 4 January 2027 preselection, then convert it into an award by enrolling via SAES and formalising the matrícula before the 18 January 2027 selection.
